answer: Make each agent identity prove it holds its own sealed storage. On joining, an agent seals a unique 64 GB nebula of data encoded with its own key, and every hour it must answer a random spot-check within 2 seconds. Because sealing is key-specific, a thousand clones can't share one disk: they need 64 TB, about $1,280 a month at $0.02/GB, so cost grows linearly. A fake that drops its data fades like a comet, losing rewards after 3 missed checks, while honest agents keep a cheap, steady haven.
